aggregation: Same dataset/protocol/source hashes; five optimizer seeds per method; sample SD ddof=1

SC-Auto-Synthetic.annotation_count_definition: known 0/1 entity-query annotations, not positive-only labels
SC-Auto-Synthetic.annotation_sampling: one independent uniformly selected non-purged query per entity, plus distinct uniform entity-query samples to the budget; independent RNG stream

memory.indices_reference: signals.jsonl: signal_id, joined to texts.jsonl via text_id

SC-Auto-Synthetic.source_mask_rule: up to six firm/material warnings ranked by observed severity times confidence; no hidden shock IDs
limitations: Original SC-Auto/SC-Semi/SC-Energy observations and original table results were not recovered.
Matching aggregate sizes does not reproduce original topology, distributions, provenance or performance.
All names, texts, dates, capacities, events and labels are generated; none identify actual companies.
Hash text embeddings are diagnostic features, not embeddings from the paper's 8B LLM.
The simulator uses independent monthly scenarios, not a continuous historical replay.
